findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 21 mm is observed in the body of the pancreas. Retropancreatic tissue invasion is noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the superior mesenteric vein, suggesting invasion. The tumor extends beyond the inferior border of the duodenum. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in three nodes at station 8p and one node at station 18. No other metastases are observed.
